html:
The Naniaba were a small Native American people on the lower Tombigbee and Alabama rivers, just north of Mobile Bay in what is now Alabama. The map spells them Naniaho.

Little is known of them. French colonists of Louisiana met them around 1700 near their new fort at Mobile, living close to the Mobile and Tohome peoples. They likely spoke a Muskogean language. Disease and war shrank their numbers through the 1700s, and their survivors seem to have merged with the Choctaw or the Creek.
